function inspectAfter(values: (number | undefined)[], mutate: () => void, limit = 100) {
  Object.defineProperty(values, "0", {
    get() { mutate(); return 1; },
    enumerable: true,
  });
  console.dir(values, { getters: true, maxArrayLength: limit });
}

const appended = [1, 2, 3];
inspectAfter(appended, () => { appended.push(4); });
const extended = [1, 2, 3];
inspectAfter(extended, () => { extended[4] = 5; });
const limited = [1, 2, 3];
inspectAfter(limited, () => { limited.push(4); }, 2);
const shortened = [1, 2, 3];
inspectAfter(shortened, () => { shortened.length = 1; });
const deleted: (number | undefined)[] = [1, 2, 3];
inspectAfter(deleted, () => { delete deleted[1]; });
const sparse = [1, , 3];
inspectAfter(sparse, () => { sparse.push(4); });
const hidden = [1, , 3];
inspectAfter(hidden, () => { Object.defineProperty(hidden, "2", { enumerable: false }); });

const removed: (number | undefined)[] = [, 1, 3];
Object.defineProperty(removed, "1", {
  get() { delete removed[2]; return 1; },
  enumerable: true,
});
try {
  console.dir(removed, { getters: true });
} catch (error) {
  console.log(String(error));
}
